recognition.prompt: Scratch the back of your head.
Rest a hand on top of your head.
Put both hands on your hips.
Give a thumbs-up during a conversation.
Rub your chin as though thinking.

murders.title: Clothes peg
murders.instruction: Clip a clothes peg onto your chosen person’s coat or clothing.

murders.title: Dagger note
murders.instruction: Place a paper note with a dagger drawn on it in your chosen person’s shoe, coat or pocket.

murders.title: Pat on the back
murders.instruction: Give your chosen person a light pat on the back.

murders.title: Tap on the upper arm
murders.instruction: Gently tap your chosen person’s upper arm.

murders.title: Hand on the shoulder
murders.instruction: Briefly place a hand on your chosen person’s shoulder.

murders.title: Tap on the knee
murders.instruction: Gently tap your chosen person’s knee.

murders.title: High-five
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to give you a high-five.

murders.title: Fist bump
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to give you a fist bump.

murders.title: Handshake
murders.instruction: Shake hands with your chosen person.

murders.title: Offer some food
murders.instruction: Offer your chosen person some food. Making the offer completes the task.

murders.title: Offer a drink
murders.instruction: Offer your chosen person a drink. Making the offer completes the task.

murders.title: Pass something
murders.instruction: Ask your chosen person to pass you something. The task is complete when they pass it to you.

murders.title: Offer a seat
murders.instruction: Offer your chosen person a seat. The task is complete when they sit down.

murders.title: Look over there
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to look at something you point to.

murders.title: Look over a shoulder
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to look over their shoulder.

murders.title: Ask for the time
murders.instruction: Ask your chosen person for the time. Asking the question completes the task.

murders.title: Say yes
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to say “yes” in answer to a question.

murders.title: Say your name
murders.instruction: Get your chosen person to say your name.
